description: The horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with different evaluation criteria for the paper “A Generative-AI-Driven Claim Retrieval System Capable of Detecting and Retrieving Claims from Social Media Platforms in Multiple Languages.” The category axis is vertical and labeled “Criterion,” listing (top to bottom) Relevant FCs, FC Summary, Relevance Explanation, Clarity and Simplicity, Overall Summary, Filters, and Veracity Explanation. The value axis is horizontal and labeled “Number of Participants,” shown on a linear scale from 0 to 6 with tick marks at 0, 2, 4, and 6. Each criterion is represented by a single solid-colored horizontal bar with a numeric value label at the bar’s right end: Relevant FCs (dark purple) reaches 6, FC Summary (dark blue-gray) reaches 5, Relevance Explanation (teal) reaches 3, Clarity and Simplicity (teal-green) reaches 3, Overall Summary (green) reaches 2, Filters (olive green) reaches 1, and Veracity Explanation (yellow-green) reaches 1. The bars appear ordered from highest to lowest value (descending), and no bars are shown as stacked or grouped; emphasis is limited to the value annotations at the ends of the bars.
